Hi,
When I use the FIRMA, I found there has one row code like this:
qn <- QuantileNormalization(csBC, typesToUpdate="pm")
i want to know what does the "pm" means. If I use MoEx-1_0-st-v1 chip,that is the same?

Best,
Jiang

messages.author: 9c09694062cb7736
messages.subject: RE: [aroma.affymetrix] a question
parts:
Hi Jiang,

Briefly, the PM means "perfect match" - the 25-mer sequence of A, T, C and G perfectly matches the compliment to the sequence of interest.
MM means "mismatch" - the 13th nucleotide does not match the compliment of the sequence of interest
(G is switched with C, A is switched with T).

see e.g.
http://www.affymetrix.com/support/technical/technotes/25mer_technote.pdf

Some data preprocessing algorithms such as RMA have versions that only use the
perfect match data. The issues are the same for the MoEx-1_0-st-v1 chip.

Steven McKinney
